_comment: Alert rules over the nodes' own syslog (ADR-039): each node's disks and its bonded lan uplink.

rules.name: disk-errors
rules._comment: Disk trouble is a condition, not an event, and its sources speak rarely: smartd re-warns every few hours, ZED in bursts. Looking back a day, it stays firing while any disk error was seen, mails once a day (repeat), and resolves after a quiet day. ZED: class=checksum|io|data|deadman, or a vdev entering a bad state. smartd / kernel: pending or uncorrectable sectors, SMART failure, I/O error, matched as smartd spells them, not case-blind: 'SMART Prefailure Attribute: … changed from 100 to 64' is an attribute moving at every boot, not a failure. logging/test.sh Check 0 runs real lines against this filter. Only those three sources' streams (unit): the match is a backtracking regex, and over a day of a node's whole syslog (auditd alone is ~500k lines) every minute it kept a 2-core logging VM busy.
rules.title: DiskErrors
rules.match: class=(checksum|io|data|deadman) |vdev_state=(DEGRADED|FAULTED|UNAVAIL|REMOVED)|SMART.*FAILED|FAILED SMART|Failed SMART|SMART Failure|(?i:I/O error|pool .*(DEGRADED|FAULTED|UNAVAIL)|Currently unreadable|Offline uncorrectable)
rules.summary: Disk or ZFS errors on a Proxmox node in the last 24 hours (ZED pool events, smartd sector warnings, kernel I/O errors). Repeated once a day while they continue.

rules.name: lan-leg-down
rules.title: LanLegDown
rules.headline: lan uplink lost a leg
rules._comment: A leg is lost when it went down more often than it came back in the window: a boot flaps a DAC leg (up, down, up within a second) with one timestamp, so counts decide, not order. Per leg (host, slave); `or` keeps a leg that only went down.
rules.expr: (sum by (host, slave) (count_over_time(__SELECTOR__ |~ `lanbond: \(slave [^)]+\): link status definitely down` | regexp `\(slave (?P<slave>[^)]+)\): link status definitely` [5m])) - sum by (host, slave) (count_over_time(__SELECTOR__ |~ `lanbond: \(slave [^)]+\): link status definitely up` | regexp `\(slave (?P<slave>[^)]+)\): link status definitely` [5m]))) or sum by (host, slave) (count_over_time(__SELECTOR__ |~ `lanbond: \(slave [^)]+\): link status definitely down` | regexp `\(slave (?P<slave>[^)]+)\): link status definitely` [5m]))
rules.summary: A leg of a node's bonded lan uplink went down and did not come back. The node runs on the rest; one more port or switch failure cuts it off. See: site-manager node network show <host>.

rules.name: pve-auth-failure
rules.title: ProxmoxAuthFailure
rules.headline: Proxmox sign-in failures
rules.summary: More than five failed sign-ins to Proxmox's web UI or API from one address in ten minutes. The UI is reached only from the management zone and the admin VPN.
rules._comment: pvedaemon's message starts with a space (seen on hrossen).
